-- One GlobalString read. See this file's header: the table is the player's own, executed -- off their chain at boot, and absent in a bare-XML harness. local function gs(key, fallback) local value = getglobal(key) if value and value ~= "" then return value end return fallback or "" end
-- ── Retail-only text, retired (director's call, 2026-08-29) ──────────────────────────── -- The Home page is entirely GlobalStrings, executed off the player's own chain — so these -- are Blizzard's 2006 strings, and three of them point at a company that stopped answering -- in 2006. Overridden here, BEFORE the markup below resolves its global-string attributes -- (the loader walks a document's top-level items in order, and `resolve_text` reads the -- live global), which is why this sits above the frames rather than in an OnLoad. -- -- Do not spell a key-lookup attribute out in prose anywhere in this file: -- `every_shipped_text_attribute_answers_against_the_real_global_strings` sweeps the raw -- file for that attribute and would try to resolve the example as a real key. -- -- Deliberately a SHORT list. Everything else on the page still reads true on any server -- with GMs — what a GM will and will not help with is a policy, not a URL, and rewriting -- policy prose we did not author would be a bigger change than the one asked for. -- -- PVP_POLICY_URL a dead http:// link to worldofwarcraft.com/policy/pvp.shtml. -- HELPFRAME_HOME_ISSUE3 its last sentence exists only to introduce that link, so it goes -- with it; the PvP guidance before it is kept verbatim. -- HELPFRAME_HOME_TEXT2 "utilise the forums and the website" + two more dead links. -- -- Emptying the two FontStrings is enough: the page is one anchor chain (each element hangs -- off the one above), so the button row simply rides up into the space they leave. PVP_POLICY_URL = "" HELPFRAME_HOME_TEXT2 = "" HELPFRAME_HOME_ISSUE3 = "Most PVP issues can be resolved through the PVP game mechanics. " .. "GM's will not be able to assist in many cases. The exceptions to this rule are " .. "any behaviors that fall under the harassment policy of the realm you are playing on."
-- ── Constants (ref-lua l.162, l.166) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- The reference's other four (HELPFRAME_BULLET_SPACING, HELPFRAME_SECTION_SPACING, -- MAX_GENERAL_BULLETS, NUM_GM_CATEGORIES_TO_DISPLAY) went with the pages that read them — -- header, WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE 5. GMTICKET_CHECK_INTERVAL = 600 -- ref-lua l.162: 10 minutes -- The petition queue starts ASSUMED UP (ref-lua l.166), so the window is usable before the -- first UPDATE_GM_STATUS lands. Public because the HELP_TICKET dialog below reads it. PETITION_QUEUE_ACTIVE = 1
-- Seconds until the next GetGMTicket poll while a ticket is open (ref-lua l.495/548). A -- file-local, not the reference's leaked global: one reader, in this file. local refreshTime
-- ── The category every ticket this window files is filed under (OURS, decision 1687) ──── -- With the category list gone there is nothing to pick from, so the window has to say -- "uncategorised" out loud rather than pick a plausible id and be wrong ten times out of -- ten. 0 is that value, and both halves of why are read off vmangos rather than assumed: -- -- · **It reaches the server.** `HandleGMTicketCreateOpcode`'s ONLY validation of the -- category is `if (packet.ticketType >= GMTICKET_MAX) return;` -- (Handlers/GMTicketHandler.cpp:112) with `GMTICKET_MAX == 11` — the enum runs -- `GMTICKET_STUCK = 1` (SharedDefines.h:1776) to `GMTICKET_CHARACTER = 10` (l.1785), -- so 11 is the first refused value. The test is a one-sided `>=`, and 0 is on the other -- side of it: it passes, and is stored by the `SetTicketType` two lines later. -- (`CMSG_GMTICKET_UPDATETEXT`'s handler range-checks nothing at all and stores it the -- same way.) -- · **It reads as nothing, not as something wrong.** `GmTicket::GetTicketCategoryName` -- (GMTicketMgr.cpp:205-232) switches on 1..10 and falls through to return "Unknown", and -- that is the string the GM broadcast carries (`SendGMTicketText(LANG_COMMAND_TICKETNEW, -- …, ticket->GetTicketCategoryName(...), …)`). So a GM's queue and the new-ticket -- notification both read "Unknown" — which is the truth — instead of heading the ticket -- with a category the player never chose. Decision 1673 recorded what filing under the -- WRONG id costs: the ticket is silently re-filed under someone else's heading. -- -- 1673 also recorded the other side of this: `client_command_for` used to refuse anything -- outside 1..=10, which was right while the only producer was a DBC-keyed button. It now -- admits 0 for this window (that guard is the Rust half, not this file's). local TICKET_CATEGORY_UNCATEGORIZED = 0
-- ref-lua l.5-8. The reference defines this up here because GENERAL_HELPFRAME stored it as -- a table value ("Ugly, but needs to be up here", its own comment); that table is gone and -- the seat is now Home's own Auto-Unstuck button, but the function is unchanged — it is -- still the client-side unstick (`Stuck()` casts spell 7355, decision 1673) rather than -- anything to do with a ticket. function HelpFrameUnstick_OnClick() Stuck() HideUIPanel(HelpFrame) end
-- ── The key → page routing table (ref-lua l.11-27) ───────────────────────────────────── -- Two pages, two keys (1687). The reference's other twelve entries — the ten -- GMTicketCategory.dbc ids, "GMHome" and "Stuck" — named the pages that went with them. -- The table stays a table of `{ name = … }` records rather than collapsing to a name→name -- map, because that record shape is what an addon reading HELPFRAME_FRAMES sees, and -- HelpFrame_ShowFrame below still walks it exactly as the reference's does. HELPFRAME_FRAMES = {} HELPFRAME_FRAMES["Home"] = { name = "HelpFrameHome" } HELPFRAME_FRAMES["OpenTicket"] = { name = "HelpFrameOpenTicket" }
-- Fit a button to its label, the reference's arithmetic (`+40`, ref-xml l.375/1341 and -- ref-lua l.307/334) on the house's measure verb. See divergence 2 in the header for why -- this is `GetTextWidth` and not the label's laid-out `GetWidth`. Both Home buttons run -- through it from that page's OnShow, which is what keeps the pair's gutter honest when a -- locale makes one of the two labels longer. function HelpFrameButton_FitToText(button) if not button then return end button:SetWidth(button:GetTextWidth() + 40) end
-- ── The window (ref-lua l.168-194) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- The reference's tab handling is commented out in its own OnLoad (ref-lua l.170-171) and -- OnShow (l.176) — 1.12 ships this window with no tab strip — so it is not transcribed. function HelpFrame_OnLoad(frame) frame:RegisterEvent("UPDATE_GM_STATUS") end
function HelpFrame_OnShow(frame) HelpFrame_ShowFrame("Home") if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end PlaySound("igCharacterInfoOpen") GetGMStatus() end
-- ref-lua l.183-194. arg1 == 1 means the petition queue is up; anything else takes it down, -- and -1 additionally says so out loud. Against vmangos, SMSG_GMTICKETSYSTEMSTATUS only -- ever carries 0 or 1, so the -1 leg is faithful but unreachable here (header note). function HelpFrame_OnEvent() if event == "UPDATE_GM_STATUS" then if arg1 == 1 then PETITION_QUEUE_ACTIVE = 1 else PETITION_QUEUE_ACTIVE = nil if arg1 == -1 then StaticPopup_Show("HELP_TICKET_QUEUE_DISABLED") end end end end
-- ref-lua l.196-229. `key` is either a HELPFRAME_FRAMES key ("Home", "OpenTicket") or -- something unknown, which falls through to the ticket editor — the reference's own -- default, and the reason 1687 could take twelve keys out of the table without breaking an -- addon that still passes one: `HelpFrame_ShowFrame(4)` used to open the Item page and now -- opens the ticket box, which is where that click was headed two pages later anyway. -- -- `ticketType` is the reference's own second parameter and stays in the signature (it is -- addon-visible API), but no caller in this file passes it any more — the GM category -- button that used to was the only one. An addon that still passes it therefore preloads -- the field the EDIT leg sends back, which is the reference's own meaning for it; a create -- ignores it and sends 0 (see HelpFrameOpenTicketSubmit_OnClick). function HelpFrame_ShowFrame(key, ticketType) if HelpFrame.openFrame then HelpFrame.openFrame:Hide() end
-- Asking for the editor with the queue down closes the window and says why. if key == "OpenTicket" and not PETITION_QUEUE_ACTIVE then HideUIPanel(HelpFrame) StaticPopup_Show("HELP_TICKET_QUEUE_DISABLED") return end
local frame local frameInfo = HELPFRAME_FRAMES[key] if frameInfo then frame = getglobal(frameInfo.name) else frame = getglobal(HELPFRAME_FRAMES["OpenTicket"].name) end frame:Show() HelpFrame.openFrame = frame
if ticketType then HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketType = ticketType end end
-- ref-lua l.351-359. Opening the window dismisses both ticket dialogs — you are about to be -- shown the same choice in a bigger frame. function ToggleHelpFrame() if HelpFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(HelpFrame) else ShowUIPanel(HelpFrame) StaticPopup_Hide("HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM") StaticPopup_Hide("HELP_TICKET") end end
-- ── The ticket editor (ref-lua l.389-486) ────────────────────────────────────────────── -- UPDATE_TICKET's arguments, the reference's own block comment (ref-lua l.409-423): -- arg1 category · arg2 description · arg3 ticket age (days) · arg4 oldest ticket (days) -- arg5 how stale that oldest-ticket figure is (days; > 1 hour means bad data) -- arg6 assigned-to-GM flag (0 no, 1 a GM, 2 the escalation queue) -- arg7 opened-by-GM flag (0 never, 1 yes) function HelpFrameOpenTicket_OnEvent(eventName) -- The GM SURVEY branch, structurally faithful and deliberately inert (header, NOT HERE 1). The -- reference dresses the toast as a survey invitation, flashes it, and returns; we take -- the same early return so nothing below can misread a survey event as a ticket, but we -- neither paint nor flash it, because GMSurveyFrame_LoadUI (the thing the toast would -- then open) does not exist here. CHOSEN_FOR_GMSURVEY (GlobalStrings l.749) and -- UIFrameFlash go with it. if eventName == "GMSURVEY_DISPLAY" then return end
if arg1 and arg1 ~= 0 then -- There IS an open ticket. TicketStatusTitleText:SetText(gs("TICKET_STATUS1")) -- GlobalStrings l.4238 -- The SERVER's category for the ticket that already exists (1687) — a GM may have -- re-filed it off "Unknown" onto a real heading with `.ticket`. Information -- arriving, not a value this window chose: nothing here lets the player pick one. -- An EDIT sends it straight back so that GM's work survives the edit; a CREATE has -- no such value and sends 0. See HelpFrameOpenTicketSubmit_OnClick. HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketType = arg1 HelpFrameOpenTicketText:SetText(arg2)
-- The reference's `ticketFrameHeight` (35 / 40 / 52) is DEAD WEIGHT and is -- dropped: it is assigned on three legs (ref-lua l.424, 444, 451) and read on -- none — the toast's height comes from the measured text at l.460, below. -- ReputationFrame.xml's precedent for dropping the reference's own unread locals. local statusText HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer = nil if arg7 == 1 then -- A GM has already opened it: no estimate, just a state. if arg6 == 2 then statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_ESCALATED") -- l.2020 else statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_SERVICE_SOON") -- l.2022 end else -- Estimate = how much older the oldest open ticket is than yours, in seconds. local estimatedWaitTime = (arg4 - arg3) * 24 * 60 * 60 if estimatedWaitTime < 0 then estimatedWaitTime = 0 end
-- 0.042 days is ~1 hour: the reference's own "this data is stale, do not quote a -- number" threshold (its comment at ref-lua l.415). if arg4 < 0 or arg5 < 0 or arg5 > 0.042 then statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_UNAVAILABLE") -- l.2023 elseif estimatedWaitTime > 7200 then statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_HIGH_VOLUME") -- l.2021 elseif estimatedWaitTime > 300 then statusText = format(gs("GM_TICKET_WAIT_TIME", "%s"), SecondsToTime(estimatedWaitTime, 1)) -- l.2024 -- Only this leg arms the live countdown below. HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer = estimatedWaitTime else statusText = gs("GM_TICKET_SERVICE_SOON") -- l.2022 end end if statusText then TicketStatusTime:Show() TicketStatusTime:SetText(statusText) TicketStatusFrame:SetHeight(TicketStatusTitleText:GetHeight() + TicketStatusTime:GetHeight() + 20) end
HelpFrameOpenTicket.hasTicket = 1 HelpFrameOpenTicketSubmit:SetText(gs("EDIT_TICKET")) -- l.965 HelpFrameOpenTicketCancel:SetText(gs("EXIT")) -- l.1933 HelpFrameOpenTicketLabel:SetText(gs("HELPFRAME_OPENTICKET_EDITTEXT")) -- l.2216 else -- No open ticket. On the wire the server answers a no-ticket -- CMSG_GMTICKET_GETTICKET with a status-only body and the app fires UPDATE_TICKET -- with a single arg1 = 0 — this leg is what puts the form back to SUBMIT/CANCEL, -- so it is load-bearing, not defensive. HelpFrameOpenTicketText:SetText("") HelpFrameOpenTicket.hasTicket = nil HelpFrameOpenTicketSubmit:SetText(gs("SUBMIT")) -- l.4211 HelpFrameOpenTicketCancel:SetText(gs("CANCEL")) -- l.465 HelpFrameOpenTicketLabel:SetText(gs("HELPFRAME_OPENTICKET_TEXT")) -- l.2217 end end
-- ref-lua l.478-486. Edit vs create is the only difference, and both close the window. -- -- **The two legs send DIFFERENT categories, and that is the whole of 1687's care.** -- -- A CREATE has nothing to go on — this window never lets the player pick — so it sends -- TICKET_CATEGORY_UNCATEGORIZED and the GM's queue reads "Unknown", which is true. -- -- An EDIT sends `HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketType` back: the category the SERVER last told us -- this ticket is filed under. That is not the window claiming a category, it is the window -- declining to destroy one. `HandleGMTicketUpdateTextOpcode` range-checks nothing and calls -- `SetTicketType(TicketType(packet.type))` unconditionally (vmangos GMTicketHandler.cpp:60), -- so whatever this leg sends BECOMES the ticket's category — send 0 here and a GM who had -- re-filed the ticket onto a real heading watches it drop back to "Unknown" the moment the -- player fixes a typo. Echoing the server's own value is the only leg that leaves a GM's -- work alone; on a ticket the server itself filed as 0, it is 0 either way. -- -- The fallback matters for exactly one case: `hasTicket` is set by UPDATE_TICKET, which -- also sets `ticketType`, so the two cannot disagree — but a stale VM (a `/reload` between -- the answer and the click) could leave the field nil, and nil is not a category. function HelpFrameOpenTicketSubmit_OnClick() local text = HelpFrameOpenTicketText:GetText() if HelpFrameOpenTicket.hasTicket then UpdateGMTicket(HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketType or TICKET_CATEGORY_UNCATEGORIZED, text) else NewGMTicket(TICKET_CATEGORY_UNCATEGORIZED, text) end HideUIPanel(HelpFrame) end
-- ── The toast (ref-lua l.488-501) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Entering the world asks for the ticket; every UPDATE_TICKET after that shows or hides the -- toast, and the temporary-enchant column steps down out of its way. The -175 restore is -- BuffFrame's own declared anchor, not the reference's -180 (header, divergence 3). function TicketStatusFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD" then GetGMTicket() elseif arg1 ~= 0 then frame:Show() if TemporaryEnchantFrame then TemporaryEnchantFrame:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "UIParent", "TOPRIGHT", -205, -frame:GetHeight()) end refreshTime = GMTICKET_CHECK_INTERVAL else frame:Hide() if TemporaryEnchantFrame then TemporaryEnchantFrame:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "UIParent", "TOPRIGHT", -175, -13) end end end
-- ref-lua l.544-561. Two independent timers on one tick: a 10-minute re-poll of the server, -- and the local countdown of the estimate it last gave us. Runs only while the toast is up. function TicketStatus_OnUpdate(elapsed) if HelpFrameOpenTicket.hasTicket then if refreshTime then refreshTime = refreshTime - elapsed if refreshTime <= 0 then refreshTime = GMTICKET_CHECK_INTERVAL GetGMTicket() end end if HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer then HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer = HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer - elapsed TicketStatusTime:SetText(format(gs("GM_TICKET_WAIT_TIME", "%s"), SecondsToTime(HelpFrameOpenTicket.ticketTimer, 1))) end end end
-- The toast's click. The reference writes this body TWICE — TicketStatusButton's OnClick -- (ref-xml l.1485-1496) and the frame's own OnMouseUp (ref-xml l.1513-1524) are character -- for character identical, because the 32px icon does not cover the whole 208px toast. -- One function, wired from both. function TicketStatus_OnClick() if TicketStatusFrame.hasGMSurvey then -- The survey branch (header, NOT HERE 1): the reference opens GMSurveyFrame and hides the -- toast. Deferred, and deliberately not stubbed into "hide the toast" — that would -- silently eat a survey the player agreed to take. return elseif StaticPopup_Visible("HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM") or StaticPopup_Visible("HELP_TICKET") then StaticPopup_Hide("HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM") StaticPopup_Hide("HELP_TICKET") elseif not HelpFrame:IsVisible() then StaticPopup_Show("HELP_TICKET") end end
-- ── The three ticket dialogs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Registered HERE, not in UiPanels.xml, and that is this house's rule rather than a -- preference: only the generic DELETE_ITEM lives with the engine; every other entry ships -- with the window that raises it (BinderConfirm, MailFrame, AuctionFrame, BankFrame, -- PetActionBar, …). All three of these are raised from this file and from nowhere else — -- HELP_TICKET_QUEUE_DISABLED by HelpFrame_OnEvent and HelpFrame_ShowFrame, HELP_TICKET by -- the toast's click, HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM by HELP_TICKET's own Cancel. -- -- Note the nesting: HELP_TICKET's Cancel shows ABANDON_CONFIRM *before* the click's own -- hide, so a second dialog instance must be free. STATICPOPUP_NUMDIALOGS is 2 and this is -- the second flow (after decline-a-res) that needs both.
-- StaticPopup.lua l.163-168. StaticPopupDialogs["HELP_TICKET_QUEUE_DISABLED"] = { text = gs("HELP_TICKET_QUEUE_DISABLED"), -- GlobalStrings l.2270 button1 = gs("OKAY"), -- l.2818 showAlert = 1, timeout = 0, }
-- StaticPopup.lua l.331-343. StaticPopupDialogs["HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM"] = { text = gs("HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM"), -- l.2267 button1 = gs("YES"), -- l.5463 button2 = gs("NO"), -- l.2794 OnAccept = function() DeleteGMTicket() end, timeout = 0, whileDead = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, }
-- StaticPopup.lua l.344-364. No hideOnEscape, by the reference's own omission: the choice -- is Edit or Abandon, and ESC is neither. The way out is the ticket icon (TicketStatus_OnClick). StaticPopupDialogs["HELP_TICKET"] = { text = gs("HELP_TICKET_EDIT_ABANDON"), -- l.2269 button1 = gs("HELP_TICKET_EDIT"), -- l.2268 button2 = gs("HELP_TICKET_ABANDON"), -- l.2266 OnAccept = function() if PETITION_QUEUE_ACTIVE then ShowUIPanel(HelpFrame) HelpFrame_ShowFrame("OpenTicket") else HideUIPanel(HelpFrame) StaticPopup_Show("HELP_TICKET_QUEUE_DISABLED") end end, -- The reference stashes the raising frame on the new dialog and never reads it back -- (header, divergence 4). OnCancel = function() StaticPopup_Show("HELP_TICKET_ABANDON_CONFIRM") end, timeout = 0, whileDead = 1, }

Scripts.OnLoad: ScrollFrame_OnLoad() local trough = getglobal(self:GetName() .. "ScrollBarTrough") BenillaScrollTrough_Seat(trough, getglobal(self:GetName() .. "ScrollBar")) trough:Show()

Scripts.OnHide: PlaySound("igCharacterInfoClose") if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end

Scripts.OnLoad: if TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_COLOR then self:SetBackdropBorderColor(TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_COLOR.r, TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_COLOR.g, TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_COLOR.b) end if TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_COLOR then self:SetBackdropColor(TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_COLOR.r, TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_COLOR.g, TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_COLOR.b) end self:RegisterEvent("UPDATE_TICKET") self:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD")
